evidence_policy.identity_requirement: Exact Pall code must be present in a current official Pall catalogue page or an official Pall technical datasheet.
evidence_policy.competitor_cross_policy: No cross-reference is accepted without separate primary evidence.
evidence_policy.public_claim_policy: Pall performance values remain source-attributed evidence and are not ELIMFILTERS claims.

test_methods: Pall published solid-removal test basis; exact method must remain source-attributed
